name: Banana Gum
descriptions: A small, yellow, chewy gum with a strong artificial banana flavor.
Classic yellow wrapper. It loses flavor quickly but is fun while it lasts.
effects: Chewy and sweet, with that distinct banana taste.

name: Mini Chocolate Bar
descriptions: A tiny, bite-sized bar of milk chocolate.
Wrapped in shiny foil. Melts in your mouth instantly.
effects: A quick hit of smooth chocolate.
Just enough to satisfy a tiny craving.

name: Red Hard Candy
descriptions: A bright red, cherry-flavored hard candy.
Translucent and shiny. Lasts a long time if you don't crunch it.

name: Green Hard Candy
descriptions: A bright green, apple-flavored hard candy.
Sour apple taste that makes your mouth water.

name: Blue Soft Candy
descriptions: A soft, blue raspberry flavored chew.
Stretchy and sweet, leaves a blue tint on your teeth.
effects: Chewy texture that sticks to your teeth a little.

name: gummy bear
descriptions: A tiny, translucent gummy bear, slightly tacky and fruit-scented.
Soft and elastic, about the size of a fingertip.
effects: You chew the gummy bear; its sticky, sugary chew bursts with bright artificial fruit flavor.
It leaves a sugary film on your teeth and makes you want a sip of water afterward.

name: Individual Fruit Gummy
descriptions: A tiny, translucent gummy fruit, slightly tacky and fruit-scented.
Soft and elastic, about the size of a fingertip.
effects: You chew the gummy fruit; its sticky, sugary chew bursts with bright artificial fruit flavor.
It leaves a sugary film on your teeth and makes you want a sip of water afterward.
